data.name: Assiratun
data.long_meaning: Assiratun is the Arabic name for 'The Bridge.' It is a symbolic name for the bridge that leads us from this world to the next. It is a reminder of the importance of following the correct path in life, as the bridge is the only way to cross the river that separates us from our ultimate destination.

in_arabic.name: عسيرتون
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عسير و يعني الطريق الشاق او الصعب

in_urdu.name: عسیرتون
in_urdu.meaning: عسیرتون کا مطلب ہے مشکل طريقہ یا سخت سفر
in_urdu.long_meaning: عسیرتون ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ع-س-ر' کے روٹ سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مشکل طريقہ یا سخت سفر۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا کے مسلم معاشرے میں گہری اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جب اس کے روحانی اور ثقافتی سیاق کو سمجھا جائے۔

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, Assiratun holds great symbolic significance as the pathway to paradise. It is often depicted as a narrow bridge spanning over a wide and deep river. This bridge is named Sirat in Arabic, and it is said to be very narrow, fine as a cobweb, and very tight. Those who cross it are only able to do so one foot at a time, with the help of Allah's grace. Therefore, the name Assiratun can be seen as a reminder of the importance of staying on the right path and avoiding any wrongdoings, as the bridge is the only way to cross and reach the ultimate destination.
data.spiritual_significance: Assiratun also holds deep spiritual significance as it represents the bridge between this world and the next. It serves as a reminder of the fundamental importance of living a righteous life and adhering to the teachings of Islam. It is a reminder that our actions in this world will have consequences in the next, and that the bridge is the only way to cross over to the realm of Allah. This name is a powerful reminder of the importance of staying focused on our spiritual journey and striving towards a close relationship with Allah, as the destruction of the bridge would mean being lost in this world forever.
